why:
Серия Установка глазами мастера. Опирается на успешный формат честного процесса монтажа (у Weglass 10 тысяч просмотров и у собственного ролика 47 тысяч), демонстрируя надежность и мастерство.
Часть кадров — из вирусного ролика вашей ниши (32.0 млн просмотров), чтобы разогнать охват; ваш продукт и призыв — в начале и в конце.
rules: Roman Group (ArtVitrage) works ONLY with glass. Main product (about 2 of 3 videos): frameless glazing of balconies and verandas (windows for balconies), pergolas, balcony blinds. Also: stained glass, decorative mirrors, glass kitchen backsplashes (skinali), glass partitions. EVERY shot must clearly show glass work as the main subject. Forbidden shots: kitchens or rooms where cabinets, appliances or furniture are the subject and no glass is clearly visible in focus; furniture or cabinets being built or assembled; woodwork; drinking glasses, glassware, bottles or jars; tiles, plaster or other trades; mosques, churches and religious images (synagogue stained glass only from his own photos). Never mention furniture. No prices, no deadlines, no client names, no other companies' objects.

problems: Nearly all frames are identical static shots of the same finished balcony glazing with minor panning
Voiceover speaks about active installation process (mounting profiles, leveling), but zero installation work or craftsmen are shown
The video lacks visual dynamics and feels like a looped slideshow
Hook claims 'до 1 мм' but nothing visually demonstrates precision or measurement
qa.fix: Replace the repetitive static balcony shots with live video footage of masters actively mounting profiles, checking levels, and sliding the glass panels open and closed.
